mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS studentId, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.name AS studentName, a.id AS attendanceId, a.status FROM student s LEFT JOIN attendance a ON s.id = a.student_id AND a.attendance_date = #{attendanceDate} AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.class_id = #{classId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.student_no
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO attendance (student_id, class_id, attendance_date, status) VALUES
(#{r.studentId}, #{classId}, #{attendanceDate}, #{r.status})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status)
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
